description: This header file provides C/C++ replacements for the standard sscanf function, intended for locale-independent parsing of strings, primarily supporting floating point number parsing. It defines a custom function 'SscanfWithCLocale' and a namespace 'cuttlefish' with a template overload for C++ usage.

classes.name: cuttlefish
classes.description: Namespace containing C++ overload of SscanfWithCLocale for easier usage with templates.

methods.name: int SscanfWithCLocale(const char * string,const char * format,Args...args)
methods.description: C function to parse formatted data from a string in a locale-independent way.

methods.name: SscanfWithCLocale (template)
methods.description: Template overload in C++ namespace for calling the C function with perfect forwarding.
